# OpenBase MCP

**Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no key on the free tier)** - official French company data for AI agents. Claude, Cursor, Copilot and any MCP client get direct access to official data on 20.5 million French companies: identity, financials, directors, BODACC legal notices, public contracts and court rulings. Fourteen tools ready to use, free, with no API key required.

```
Server type: Remote (Streamable HTTP)
Auth: None (free tier); optional identified key; Pro for premium reports
Endpoint: https://openbase.fr/api/mcp
Tools: 14 standard + 3 agent-oriented (with key) + premium report tool
Pricing: Free tier unlimited; Pro report 14.90 EUR each, no subscription
Category: Business Operations
Built by: OpenBase
```

## Why This Matters for Operators

French company due diligence normally means stitching together Sirene, INPI, BODACC, DECP and Judilibre by hand, each with its own access pattern. OpenBase joins them behind one endpoint and one query surface.

The differentiating tools are the three newer ones: `reseau_capitalistique` graphs holdings, subsidiaries and capital loops one to two levels deep for M&A due diligence, `signaux_business` returns every dynamic signal (hirings, public contracts, fundraisings, certifications, risks) in one call, and `surveiller_entreprise` sets an email alert on any event. **An agent can screen a counterparty's corporate structure, court record and public contracts in one conversation - the work that previously justified a junior analyst.**

## Tools & Capabilities

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `recherche_entreprise` | Search by name, SIREN or SIRET across 20M entities |
| `fiche_entreprise` | Full record: identity, directors, finances, BODACC, 360 score |
| `recherche_dirigeant` | Find a director by name and list all active and past mandates |
| `bilans_financiers` | Five years of accounts: revenue, result, EBITDA, ratios, debts, cash |
| `bodacc` | Legal notices: creations, changes, account filings, collective procedures |
| `apercu_solvabilite` | Free solvency overview: score plus key ratios |
| `marches_publics` | Public contracts won (DECP): object, amount, buyer, award date |
| `decisions_justice` | Court rulings via Judilibre (218k+ decisions) |
| `classement_entreprises` | Top companies by revenue, headcount, creation date, sector, department |
| `entreprises_par_secteur` | Exhaustive company lists by NAF/APE code and geography |
| `reseau_capitalistique` | Holdings, subsidiaries and capital loops (1-2 levels) |
| `signaux_business` | All dynamic signals in one call |
| `surveiller_entreprise` | Email alerts on any corporate event (auth required) |
| `autocomplete` | Fast typeahead (p95 under 50ms) for UI integration |

## Installation

```bash
claude mcp add openbase https://openbase.fr/api/mcp
```

## Configuration

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "openbase": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://openbase.fr/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

The anonymous free tier works immediately with no key. Registering an email unlocks three agent-oriented tools (360 scoring, risk alerts, company comparison) and a soft cap of 100 calls per day. Pro reports are pay-per-use at 14.90 EUR and generated by Claude Opus 4.6.

## Business Relevance

- **Audit and M&A firms** run agent-led due diligence on capital networks and serial-failers
- **Banks and insurers** automate KYB onboarding with screening signals, cutting onboarding time
- **Sales operations** enrich every CRM lead with solvency and company data instead of hand-rolled API parsing
- **Lawyers** build a counterparty's litigation map from Judilibre rulings in seconds

## Integration with CorpusIQ

OpenBase reads the French company registry; CorpusIQ reads the operating business. For an operator doing French B2B, the pair is a complete diligence stack: OpenBase's `fiche_entreprise` and `bilans_financiers` establish identity and published accounts, while CorpusIQ's Stripe, QuickBooks and HubSpot connectors show what the target or counterparty actually transacts when you are inside the business. A sales team can even close the loop: OpenBase scores the prospect, HubSpot holds the pipeline, and the agent routes follow-ups by risk level.

## Limitations

- Brand new listing with no track record yet
- France only; sources are official public data, not private credit data
- B2B data only by design - no personal emails exposed
- Premium reports are pay-per-use rather than subscription
